ruleDefinitions.name: Kavremover Dropped Binary LOLBIN Usage
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of a signed binary dropped by Kaspersky Lab Products Remover (kavremover) which can be abused as a LOLBIN to execute arbitrary commands and binaries.

sequences.query: process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ run\\ run\\-cmd\\ .*") AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cleanapi\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\kavremover\\\.exe$")))
